##### Project general facts

Antalya is a contemporary residential development that brings a refined Mediterranean-inspired lifestyle into the heart of Dubai. The architecture is defined by clean lines, open compositions, and a soft, elegant aesthetic that emphasizes light, space, and balance. A curated selection of studios and multi-bedroom apartments is thoughtfully designed with functional layouts and expansive glazing, creating bright, airy interiors that seamlessly connect indoor comfort with the surrounding environment.

The project is complemented by a range of resort-style amenities designed for both relaxation and everyday living. Residents can enjoy swimming pools, wellness and fitness spaces, landscaped outdoor lounges, and dedicated areas for families and social interaction. Each element is carefully integrated to create a cohesive community atmosphere where leisure, comfort, and connection are part of daily life.

Interiors are finished with high-quality materials, featuring warm neutral palettes, high ceilings, and modern detailing that enhances both style and practicality. Fully equipped kitchens are designed for convenience and contemporary living, while bathrooms reflect a clean, spa-like aesthetic. Apartments are offered unfurnished, allowing residents to personalize their spaces while benefiting from well-crafted layouts and premium finishing standards.

##### Location description and benefits

Dubai Sports City offers a well-balanced blend of lifestyle, wellness, and convenient connectivity. The district features international sporting facilities, green open spaces, and a vibrant atmosphere that appeals equally to families and professionals. It’s a place where everything is within easy reach — from active recreation to peaceful downtime.

Its strategic location provides direct access to major roads such as Hessa Street, Sheikh Mohammed Bin Zayed Road, and Al Khail Road, making it easy to reach Dubai Marina, JVC, Motor City, and even Dubai International Airport within minutes.

Residents enjoy a wide range of infrastructure, including prestigious schools, medical centers, supermarkets, and shopping malls such as City Centre Me’aisem and Mall of the Emirates. Beaches, golf courses, and parks are all just a short drive away, while the canal promenade within Sports City itself offers the perfect setting for evening walks, jogs, or weekend gatherings with friends and family.
